subject: Renewal packaging: tier-shift, grace bands, and uplift guardrails
thread_content:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbleai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimbleai.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal packaging: tier-shift, grace bands, and uplift guardrails

Hi Tessa,

We’re preparing for NimbleAI’s upcoming renewal and I wanted to get ahead of packaging options. Our usage pattern changed this year — sustained bursts across inference pipelines plus a couple of new product features — so our original commit sits underutilized at times and spikes the rest of the month.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood offer a clean path to shift committed units between tiers mid-term? We want predictable rates but flexibility to move volume without restarting pricing discussions.
- Second, on renewal uplift: our procurement team can accept a modest uplift, but we need a hard guardrail (a cap) on the annual renewal uplift and clarity on how overage credits/true-ups are handled.

I’ve attached a high-level usage breakdown for Q2. Can we jump on a 30-min call this week to go through options?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Infrastructure
NimbleAI
Attachment: usage_breakdown_Q2.csv (text/csv)

-----
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbleai.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal packaging: tier-shift, grace bands, and uplift guardrails

Hi Alex — really helpful context, thanks for sending the Q2 numbers. I can absolutely put together a few structured options that balance predictability with the flexibility you want.

High-level notes to prep a conversation:
- Tier-shifts: we can support a single annual re-tier event inside the contract (move X committed tokens from one tier to another) plus an optional smaller mid-year reallocation for a fee. We’ll map the exact mechanics (effective date, proration, and any short/overrun true-up) in the SOW.
- Uplift cap: we typically propose a max annual uplift range (8–20% depending on commitment term). For renewals where customers commit to a multi-year plan, we can tighten that cap.
- Overage handling: we offer monthly true-ups based on actual per-token usage at the agreed rates; credits/bridging options can smooth predictable spikes.

Proposed next step — 30 min call Thursday 7/22 or Friday 7/23. I’ll draft two numbered options (Conservative and Elastic) and attach a short playbook with an example pricing math.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0123
Attachment: NimbleAI_Renewal_Playbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

-----
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: NimbleAI renewal — suggested uplift bands

Tessa / Vivek — quick internal note ahead of the call with Alex:
- Option A (Conservative): 12-month renewal, 10% uplift cap, one annual tier-shift allowed, no mid-year reallocation. Small signing credit (~2% ARR equivalent) for committing to 12 months.
- Option B (Elastic): 24-month renewal, 6% annual uplift cap, one annual tier-shift + one mid-year micro-reallocation (up to 10% of committed volume) for a nominal fee. 4% ARR signing credit.
- Pricing levers: we can lean on commit term and signing credit to compress the uplift cap. Also offer a short-term bridge credit if they sign before 8/15.

I’ll be on the call to help model the numbers.

—Steph

-----
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbleai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimbleai.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal packaging: tier-shift, grace bands, and uplift guardrails

Thanks Tessa — Thursday works for us (7/22 at 11am PT). A couple of clarifying constraints from procurement before the call:
- NimbleAI cannot accept uplift above 12% in year one; we’d need stronger incentives to go to 15+.
- Any mid-year reallocation must be non-disruptive to reporting and must not reset committed-term discounts.

We’ll have our CFO on the call as well.

—Alex

-----
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbleai.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 13:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal packaging: tier-shift, grace bands, and uplift guardrails

Alex — great to meet your CFO on the call earlier. Recap and next steps below.

Recap of agreed principles:
- We can commit to a firm first-year uplift cap of 12% with a conditional compression to 8% if NimbleAI signs a 24-month term and increases the committed baseline by at least 15% on effective date.
- We’ll allow one annual tier-shift (free) plus a single mid-year micro-reallocation (<= 10% of committed tokens) for a predefined fee (0.5% of annual commit). Micro-reallocations will not change discount tiers for the remaining commitment period.
- Overage true-ups will continue monthly at the agreed per-token rates; we’ll apply a one-time bridging credit at renewal to offset expected Q3 burst usage (credit amount will be in the formal proposal).

Attached is a preliminary two-option proposal with worked examples and a DocuSign link for the 24-month Elastic option should you want to fast-track (link below).

Action items:
- Alex / NimbleAI: review attached playbook and example numbers; confirm whether you prefer Conservative (12-mo) or Elastic (24-mo).
- Tessa: send formal SOW with detailed reallocation mechanics and DocuSign for signature.
- Vivek / Lauren: assist on drafting the SOW and mark the uplift-cap clause for legal review.

DocuSign: https://redwood-docusign.example/ds/ABC-987
Attachment: NimbleAI_Renewal_Playbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — talk soon.
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Tessa / Steph — I started the SOW skeleton and added the micro-reallocation fee and the uplift cap language under section 3.2. Dropped it into the shared drive (see HubSpot link in metadata). I’ll ping legal for a quick review on the uplift guardrail phrasing tomorrow.

—Vivek
